Rashi on Berakhot 56b:14:1.hebrew: ובכל קנינך - לשון מרובה הוא. אף קנים הרבה — קנה של בינה הוא:
Rashi on Berakhot 56b:14:1.english: And with all your acquisition - It is an expression of multiplicity. So too, [the case of seeing] many reeds — it is the 'acquire' of understanding.

Rashi on Berakhot 56b:14:2.hebrew: קרא קורא קירא קניא - קרא — דלעת, כדאמרינן לקמן: ״הרואה דלועין בחלום ירא שמים הוא״ — לשון ״דלו עיני למרום״ (ישעיהו ל״ח:י״ד):
Rashi on Berakhot 56b:14:2.english: Pumpkin, heart of palm, wax, reed - Kara is a pumpkin, as we say below: "One who sees pumpkins in a dream is one who fears Heaven" — an expression of "My eyes were raised on high" (Isaiah 38:14).

Rashi on Berakhot 56b:14:3.hebrew: קורא - רך הגדל בענפי הדקל בכל שנה כדרך שאר אילנות, ולשנה שניה הוא מתקשה ונעשה עץ:
Rashi on Berakhot 56b:14:3.english: Heart of palm - The tender [shoot] that grows on the branches of the date palm each year in the manner of other trees, and in the second year it hardens and becomes wood.

Rashi on Berakhot 56b:16:1.english: One who eats of its flesh - In a dream.

Rashi on Berakhot 56b:18:1.english: Whether running - When it is running.

Rashi on Berakhot 56b:19:1.hebrew: גם עלה - קרוב לנוטריקון של גמל:
Rashi on Berakhot 56b:19:1.english: Also surely bring [you] up - [It is] close to an acronym of gamal [camel].

Rashi on Berakhot 56b:1:1.english: The king's silks - Robes of the king.

Rashi on Berakhot 56b:1:2.hebrew: דאצטליק - נחלק לב', ודוגמתו בהעור והרוטב (דף קכד.) דצלקי מצלק:
Rashi on Berakhot 56b:1:2.english: That it split open - [It was] divided into two, and a parallel to this is in [the chapter] HaOr VehaRotev (Chullin 124a): "where one split it."

Rashi on Berakhot 56b:20:1.hebrew: פלא נעשה לו - כמו שנעשה לפינחס, כדאמרינן בסנהדרין (דף פב:):
Rashi on Berakhot 56b:20:1.english: A miracle was performed for him - Just as was performed for Pinehas, as we say in Sanhedrin (82b).

Rashi on Berakhot 56b:2:1.hebrew: יעצו עליך רעה - והם הלחיים, פה שיעץ עליך רעה:
Rashi on Berakhot 56b:2:1.english: Devised evil against you - And they, the cheeks, are the mouth that devised evil against you.

Rashi on Berakhot 56b:3:1.hebrew: חרון אף - ניכר בחוטם, שמתחמם ומוציא הבל. על כן הוא קרוי חרון אף:
Rashi on Berakhot 56b:3:1.english: Wrath - It is evident in the nose, which heats up and emits vapor. Therefore, it is called charon af [literally, burning of the nose].

Rashi on Berakhot 56b:3:2.english: You will not need the labor of your hands - For you will become wealthy.

Rashi on Berakhot 56b:3:3.english: You will die in glory - You will die in honor and splendor.

Rashi on Berakhot 56b:4:1.hebrew: אמו בעל - דומיא דשמן שהוא בתוך הזית, השקה את אמו:
Rashi on Berakhot 56b:4:1.english: He had relations with his mother - Just as oil is inside the olive, [so too] he watered his mother.

Rashi on Berakhot 56b:4:2.hebrew: קטיף לי כוכבא - עקרתי כוכב בחלום:
Rashi on Berakhot 56b:4:2.english: I plucked a star - I uprooted a star in a dream.

Rashi on Berakhot 56b:4:3.english: You kidnapped - For [Israel] is likened to the stars.

Rashi on Berakhot 56b:4:4.english: A load of myrtle - [This means] the shade of myrtle.

Rashi on Berakhot 56b:4:5.hebrew: נערה המאורסה - היו רגילין לעשות לה חופה של הדס בכניסתה לחופה, וקורין לה הינומא, כדאמרינן בכתובות (דף טו:): שיצאתה בהינומא וראשה פרוע:
Rashi on Berakhot 56b:4:5.english: A betrothed young woman - They were accustomed to make for her a canopy of myrtle upon her entry into the wedding canopy, and they call it a hinuma, as we say in Ketubot (15b): "that she went out with a hinuma and her head uncovered."

Rashi on Berakhot 56b:5:1.english: You removed the garments of the dead - You took the clothing off the deceased.

Rashi on Berakhot 56b:6:1.hebrew: אם כן - דלית לך התם נכסי, ואבוך לא שכיב התם:
Rashi on Berakhot 56b:6:1.english: If so - Since you have no property there, and your father did not die there.

Rashi on Berakhot 56b:6:2.hebrew: קפא - דאמרי לך היא כשורא, שבלשון פרס ויון קורין לכשורא קפא:
Rashi on Berakhot 56b:6:2.english: Kappa - [The word] that they said to you is a beam, for in the language of Persia and Greece they call a beam kappa.

Rashi on Berakhot 56b:6:3.hebrew: דיקא - הוא עשרה, שבלשון יוני קורין לעשרה דיקא. והכי אמרי לך: יש לך ממון בקורה עשירית:
Rashi on Berakhot 56b:6:3.english: Deka - It is ten, for in the Greek language they call ten "deka." And this is what they were saying to you: "You have money in the tenth beam."

Rashi on Berakhot 56b:6:4.english: That is at the head of ten - A beam that is at the head of ten.

Rashi on Berakhot 56b:8:1.hebrew: שלש שלומות הם - שלש חלומות המבשרים שלום:
Rashi on Berakhot 56b:8:1.english: There are three [signs of] peace - Three dreams that herald peace.

Rashi on Berakhot 56b:8:2.hebrew: ופרשו כאשר בסיר - אלמא פורענותא היא:
Rashi on Berakhot 56b:8:2.english: And chop [them] in pieces, as that which is in the pot - Evidently, it is [a sign of] calamity.
